tools.name: get_buyer
tools.description: One program with its current facts: what it takes, who qualifies, payout, fees, exclusivity, payment timing and process, each quoted from the buyer's page with the date read.

tools.name: get_market_facts

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_buyers, get_tool_terms · Private data: list_buyers, get_market_facts, get_tool_terms · Public sink: list_buyers, get_tool_terms.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_buyers, get_tool_terms · Private data: list_buyers, get_market_facts, get_tool_terms · Public sink: list_buyers, get_tool_terms

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
